title: Draft: reassembly: Handle retransmissions after defragmentation
description:
Mark retransmitted fragments as overlapped instead of throwing exception
in fragment_add_work() when adding fragment that does not go past the
defragmented data length.

---

This is extracted from !8931. The approach in !8931 changed from using modified `fragment_add_work()` to introducing new `fragment_add_check_with_fallback()` that can be used instead. Thanks to the new function existing uses of `fragment_add()` were not changed and thus other dissectors were not affected.

notes.body: This introduces "[Illegal Segments]" in places that previously seem fine. See https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/captures/fuzz-2016-12-22-32089.pcap for sample capture. Example packet 109400 is "SMB 93 Read AndX Response, Error: STATUS_FILE_LOCK_CONFLICT" without this change and "SMB 93 [Illegal Segments]" with this change.
If still relevant feel free to rebase and reopen
